svg.title: Compare Fully Loaded Deal Yield by Sub-Niche
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-subniche-net-yield; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Fully Loaded Deal Yield by Sub-Niche; subtitle: Five illustrative unit models use net profit divided by gross receipts.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: These independent underwriting examples are not measured market averages and do not determine the canonical scenario mix. Each deducts acquisition, selling or collection fees, incremental slippage, expected disruption loss, allocated operations, and funding cost. Settlement intervals are planning assumptions, not stated exchange policies.; caption: A higher percentage spread can still consume more cash for longer. Underwrite settlement dates, refund duties, and supplier deposits alongside each net yield.; stages: label: Multi-exchange ticket resale; value: 17% net; $170 on $1,000; numeric value: 17.0; detail: $1,000 gross less $600 acquisition, $100 exchange fees, $40 slippage, $20 disruption provision, $60 operations, and $10 funding leaves $170. Fund inventory upfront; stress-test payout seven days after event completion.; label: Suite splitting with ACH; value: 19% net; $950 on $5,000; numeric value: 19.0; detail: $5,000 gross less $3,000 suite allocation, $50 collection fees, $300 empty-seat slippage, $150 disruption provision, $500 operations, and $50 funding leaves $950. Suite minimums remain payable even when individual seats fail to sell; ACH collection does not remove refund duties.; label: Tentpole hospitality with wire; value: 20% net; $2,000 on $10,000; numeric value: 20.0; detail: $10,000 gross less $6,000 package acquisition, $100 collection fees, $500 slippage, $300 disruption provision, $900 operations, and $200 funding leaves $2,000. Apply to Super Bowl, World Cup, F1, or Final Four bundles only with documented rights; model a 90-day deposit cycle.; label: NFL and NBA playoff strips; value: 7% net; $140 on $2,000; numeric value: 7.0; detail: $2,000 gross less $1,200 acquisition, $200 exchange fees, $140 slippage, $60 disruption provision, $140 operations, and $20 funding leaves $140. Verify SSL and playoff-option transfer terms; elimination changes both inventory and refund obligations before post-event settlement.; label: Masters hospitality with card; value: 16% net; $1,600 on $10,000; numeric value: 16.0; detail: $10,000 gross less $6,000 acquisition, $200 collection fees, $700 slippage, $400 disruption provision, $900 operations, and $200 funding leaves $1,600. Verify each badge entitlement and hospitality component; model 120-day supplier exposure and continuing card disputes.

text.title: Compare Fully Loaded Deal Yield by Sub-Niche
text.tspan: Compare Fully Loaded Deal Yield by Sub-Niche

rect.title: label: Multi-exchange ticket resale; value: 17% net; $170 on $1,000; numeric value: 17.0; detail: $1,000 gross less $600 acquisition, $100 exchange fees, $40 slippage, $20 disruption provision, $60 operations, and $10 funding leaves $170. Fund inventory upfront; stress-test payout seven days after event completion.

label: Suite splitting with ACH; value: 19% net; $950 on $5,000; numeric value: 19.0; detail: $5,000 gross less $3,000 suite allocation, $50 collection fees, $300 empty-seat slippage, $150 disruption provision, $500 operations, and $50 funding leaves $950. Suite minimums remain payable even when individual seats fail to sell; ACH collection does not remove refund duties.

label: Tentpole hospitality with wire; value: 20% net; $2,000 on $10,000; numeric value: 20.0; detail: $10,000 gross less $6,000 package acquisition, $100 collection fees, $500 slippage, $300 disruption provision, $900 operations, and $200 funding leaves $2,000. Apply to Super Bowl, World Cup, F1, or Final Four bundles only with documented rights; model a 90-day deposit cycle.

label: NFL and NBA playoff strips; value: 7% net; $140 on $2,000; numeric value: 7.0; detail: $2,000 gross less $1,200 acquisition, $200 exchange fees, $140 slippage, $60 disruption provision, $140 operations, and $20 funding leaves $140. Verify SSL and playoff-option transfer terms; elimination changes both inventory and refund obligations before post-event settlement.

label: Masters hospitality with card; value: 16% net; $1,600 on $10,000; numeric value: 16.0; detail: $10,000 gross less $6,000 acquisition, $200 collection fees, $700 slippage, $400 disruption provision, $900 operations, and $200 funding leaves $1,600. Verify each badge entitlement and hospitality component; model 120-day supplier exposure and continuing card disputes.

text.title: Assumptions: These independent underwriting examples are not measured market averages and do not determine the canonical scenario mix. Each deducts acquisition, selling or collection fees, incremental slippage, expected disruption loss, allocated operations, and funding cost. Settlement intervals are planning assumptions, not stated exchange policies.
